stories.title: TSE suspende candidatura de Deltan Dallagnol ao Senado pelo Paraná

en.title: TSE suspends Deltan Dallagnol's candidacy for Senate in Paraná
en.summary: Brazil's Electoral Court suspended the Senate candidacy of former federal deputy Deltan Dallagnol pending judgment of an appeal against his registration. He is barred from campaign activities until the court rules on the matter.

stories.title: Ancelotti convoca Vanderson para substituir Wesley, cortado por lesão

en.title: Ancelotti calls Vanderson to replace Wesley, cut due to injury
en.summary: Right back Wesley was removed from the Brazilian national team due to injury. Coach Carlo Ancelotti summoned Vanderson from Monaco as his replacement.

stories.title: Unimed Costa do Sol reforça assistência às gestações de alto risco

en.title: Unimed Costa do Sol strengthens assistance for high-risk pregnancies
en.summary: About 15% of pregnancies are classified as high-risk, requiring specialized monitoring. Early assessment and coordinated care between specialists help reduce complications and improve safety for mother and baby.

stories.title: Cães aguardam por adoção responsável e novos lares em Macaé

en.title: Dogs await responsible adoption and new homes in Macaé
en.summary: The municipal animal protection agency in Macaé is promoting dogs available for adoption through professional photography on official channels. Prospective adopters must be adults with identification, tax number, and proof of residence.

stories.title: Maria Bethânia entra de vez na era dos festivais

en.title: Maria Bethânia fully enters the festival era
en.summary: Singer Maria Bethânia has been confirmed for the 2027 Salvador Summer Festival lineup, performing on January 23 at Arena Festival in Bahia, marking her full entry into the festival circuit as a major attraction.

stories.title: Pedágio fica mais caro na BR-262 a partir deste domingo; veja como ficam os valores

en.title: Tolls increase on BR-262 starting this Sunday; see the new rates
en.summary: Toll rates on BR-262 in three municipalities in Minas Gerais will increase beginning Sunday, with new charges ranging from R$ 10.20 to R$ 88.80, following a 7.68% adjustment authorized by the national transportation agency.

stories.title: Cuba restabelece conexão da rede elétrica, mas apagões continuam

en.title: Cuba restores power grid connection, but blackouts continue
en.summary: Cuba restored electricity service after its seventh nationwide blackout this year, though authorities warned outages will persist due to generation deficits amid economic and energy crisis exacerbated by U.S. sanctions.

stories.title: TSE suspende repasse de recursos e atos de campanha de Deltan Dallagnol

en.title: TSE suspends campaign activities and funding for Deltan Dallagnol
en.summary: Brazil's electoral court issued a temporary order suspending campaign activities and fund transfers to Deltan Dallagnol, a Senate candidate from Paraná, following a petition from opposing coalitions against his candidacy.

stories.title: Cuba restabelece conexão elétrica após novo apagão generalizado

en.title: Cuba restores electrical connection after new widespread blackout
en.summary: Cuba began restoring electricity service on Saturday following its seventh nationwide blackout of the year, amid an economic and energy crisis exacerbated by U.S. sanctions.

stories.title: Cuba enfrenta segundo dia de apagão após colapso da rede elétrica

en.title: Cuba faces second day of blackout after electrical grid collapse
en.summary: Cuba entered its second day of a nationwide blackout after the electrical grid collapsed, with power partially restored in the capital Havana. This is the seventh blackout of the year amid a U.S. oil embargo.

stories.title: EUA dizem ter matado quatro pessoas em ataque contra embarcação no Caribe

en.title: United States says it killed four people in attack on vessel in the Caribbean
en.summary: The U.S. military reported killing four people in an attack on a boat in the Caribbean Sea on Saturday, claiming the vessel was involved in drug trafficking, though no evidence of drugs was presented.

stories.title: Novo ataque contra embarcação deixa quatro mortos no Caribe, dizem EUA

en.title: New attack on vessel leaves four dead in Caribbean, U.S. says
en.summary: U.S. military personnel killed four people during an attack on a boat in the Caribbean Sea, operating under suspicion that the vessel was involved in international drug trafficking.

stories.title: Milton Leite reclama de pressão alta, é levado a hospital, mas prisão é mantida

en.title: Milton Leite complains of high blood pressure, is taken to hospital, but imprisonment is maintained
en.summary: Former São Paulo city councilman Milton Leite remained in custody after presenting to police, with a court finding no irregularities in his detention during a custody hearing. He was subsequently taken to a hospital for medical attention.

stories.title: Candidata chilena apoiada pelo Brasil desiste da candidatura à Secretaria-Geral da ONU

en.title: Chilean candidate supported by Brazil withdraws from candidacy for UN Secretary-General
en.summary: Former Chilean President Michelle Bachelet withdrew her candidacy for UN Secretary-General, a position Brazil had backed her for. She cited unfavorable conditions for her candidacy, including challenges to multilateralism and international law.

stories.title: Gilmar Mendes cobra imparcialidade do TSE e avisa que STF revisará atos da Corte, se necessário

en.title: Gilmar Mendes demands impartiality from TSE and warns that STF will review Court's acts if necessary
en.summary: Supreme Court minister Gilmar Mendes publicly called for the Electoral Court to act impartially and warned that the Supreme Court would review electoral decisions if needed. He cautioned court members against using their positions for electoral purposes.

stories.title: Trump anuncia "Força-Tarefa de IA" e "Czar" para impulsionar a tecnologia

en.title: Trump announces "AI Task Force" and "Czar" to boost technology
en.summary: President Donald Trump announced the creation of an AI Task Force and plans to appoint an AI Czar to advance artificial intelligence development while protecting against misuse.

stories.title: Mendonça e Fux informam à PF que não conseguem acessar dados do celular de Vorcaro

en.title: Mendonça and Fux inform PF that they cannot access Vorcaro's cell phone data
en.summary: Two Brazilian Supreme Court justices, André Mendonça and Luiz Fux, told the Federal Police they were unable to access data from the cell phone of former banker Daniel Vorcaro, despite the police providing a copy of the device's contents.
